AttachDataset.description_en: Uses a dataset of a specified version of a specified instance to provide online services
AttachDataset.description_zh: 指定实例的指定数据集版本提供在线服务

AttachIndexVersion.description_en: Brings a specified index version online
AttachIndexVersion.description_zh: 把指定版本的索引切换到线上

CheckRankingModelReachable.description_en: Checks the network connectivity of a ranking model

CreateFilteringAlgorithm.description_en: Creates a filtering table. After the filtering table is trained on Machine Learning Platform for AI (PAI), export it to MaxCompute and specify the information about the MaxCompute table in Artificial Intelligence Recommendation (AIRec)
CreateFilteringAlgorithm.description_zh: 创建召回表，目前召回表由PAI训练完成导出到odps中，在AIRec中指定ODPS表信息

CreateInstance.description_en: Creates an Artificial Intelligence Recommendation (AIRec) instance
CreateInstance.description_zh: 创建一个智能推荐实例

CreateRule.description_zh: 创建推荐策略运营规则

CreateScene.description_en: Verify the information for scenario creation

DecribeRankingModel.description_en: Queries the information of a ranking model

DeleteDataSet.description_en: Deletes a dataset of a specified version for an instance
DeleteDataSet.description_zh: 删除指定实例的指定数据集版本

DeleteFilteringAlgorithm.description_en: Deletes the configurations of a specified filtering table and the information about the related index table
DeleteFilteringAlgorithm.description_zh: 删除指定的召回配置及相关索引表信息

DeployRankingSystem.description_en: Deploys or redeploys a ranking service. For a ranking service that has been deployed, you need to redeploy the service if you modify the configurations of the service
DeployRankingSystem.description_zh: 部署/重启部署排序服务，已经部署过的服务，修改配置后必须重启部署，注：若未修改任何参数，则可以不传body

DescribeCustomAnalysisTask.description_en: Queries the results of a custom analysis task for a specified instance
DescribeCustomAnalysisTask.description_zh: 查询指定实例的仪表盘自定义分析任务结果

DescribeDataSetMessage.description_en: Queries the details of data errors for a specific dataset version in a specific instance
DescribeDataSetMessage.description_zh: 获取指定实例的指定数据集版本数据错误详情

DescribeDefaultAlgorithms.description_en: Queries the information of default algorithms

DescribeExperiment.description_en: Queries the details of an experiment

DescribeExperimentEnv.description_en: Queries information about an experiment scenario

DescribeExperimentEnvProgress.description_en: Queries the activation status of an experiment scenario
DescribeExperimentEnvProgress.description_zh: 查看实验场景开通状态

DescribeFilteringAlgorithm.description_en: Queries the configurations of a filtering table based on the ID of the filtering table
DescribeFilteringAlgorithm.description_zh: 根据指定召回表ID 获取某个召回配置信息

DescribeInstance.description_en: Queries the details about an instance based on the instance ID
DescribeInstance.description_zh: 通过指定的实例ID查看实例详情

DescribeLatestTask.description_en: Retrieves the most recent build task
DescribeLatestTask.description_zh: 获取最近一次构建的任务

DescribeQuota.description_en: Queries the quotas of an instance based on a specified instance ID
DescribeQuota.description_zh: 通过指定的实例ID查看实例的配额信息

DescribeRegions.description_zh: 查询可以使用的阿里云区域

DescribeRule.description_en: Queries detailed information about a rule
DescribeRule.description_zh: 查询一个规则的详细信息

DescribeScene.description_en: Queries the details of a scenario

DescribeSceneBucket.description_en: Queries the experiment bucket distribution in a scenario
DescribeSceneBucket.description_zh: 查看场景下实验桶分布情况

DescribeSceneThroughput.description_en: Queries the traffic of a scenario

DescribeSyncReportDetail.description_en: Retrieves the details of hourly real-time data reports
DescribeSyncReportDetail.description_zh: 获取实时数据小时级别报告细节信息

DescribeSyncReportOutliers.description_en: Retrieves outlier details from a real-time data sync report
DescribeSyncReportOutliers.description_zh: 获取实时数据报告异常明细

DescribeUserMetrics.description_en: Queries user metrics related to the conversion rate
DescribeUserMetrics.description_zh: 获取用户指标（转化率信息）

DowngradeInstance.description_en: Decreases the quotas of a specified instance
DowngradeInstance.description_zh: 降低指定实例配额 （Quota）信息

GenerateSample.description_en: Generates a sample. This operation is applicable only to samples created by replication
GenerateSample.description_zh: 生成样本，只针对复制创建的样本

GetExtraDataSource.description_en: Retrieves the details of an extra data source

GetFlowControlTask.description_en: Obtains the details of a throttling task
GetFlowControlTask.description_zh: 获取流量调控任务详情

GetLatestDataDiagnoseTaskStatus.description_en: Retrieves the status of the latest diagnostic task
GetLatestDataDiagnoseTaskStatus.description_zh: 获取最新诊断任务状态

GetRankingModelTemplate.description_en: Queries the details of a ranking model configuration
GetRankingModelTemplate.description_zh: 查看排序模型配置详情

GetRankingModelVersion.description_en: Retrieves the details of a ranking model version, including its evaluation and training results
GetRankingModelVersion.description_zh: 查看排序模型版本详情，包括评估结果和训练结果

GetRankingSystem.description_en: Retrieves the details of a sorting service

GetRankingSystemHistory.description_en: Queries a sorting service for its operation records
GetRankingSystemHistory.description_zh: 查询排序服务操作记录

GetSample.description_en: Retrieves the details of a sample

ListDashboardDetails.description_en: Queries detailed metrics for a specified instance
ListDashboardDetails.description_zh: 通过指定条件查询指定实例的细分指标

ListDashboardDetailsFlows.description_en: Queries the traffic metrics details for a specified instance
ListDashboardDetailsFlows.description_zh: 通过指定条件查询指定实例的细分流量指标

ListDashboardMetrics.description_en: Queries the dashboard metrics for a specified instance
ListDashboardMetrics.description_zh: 查询指定实例的整理仪表盘数据

ListDashboardMetricsFlows.description_en: Queries the traffic data of a specified instance from the dashboard
ListDashboardMetricsFlows.description_zh: 查询指定实例的整理仪表盘流量数据

ListDataDiagnoseReports.description_en: Retrieves data diagnostic reports. These reports include manually triggered diagnostics, daily reports, and reports generated at data startup
ListDataDiagnoseReports.description_zh: 获取数据诊断报告 （包括用户手动触发的诊断、每天产出的周期报告、数据启动时诊断的报告）

ListDataDiagnoseSampleDetails.description_en: Retrieves the sample details of a data diagnostic report
ListDataDiagnoseSampleDetails.description_zh: 获取数据诊断报告抽样明细

ListDataSet.description_en: Queries datasets of a specified instance
ListDataSet.description_zh: 获取指定实例的数据集列表

ListDataSource.description_en: Retrieves a list of data sources for a specified instance
ListDataSource.description_zh: 获取指定实例的数据源列表信息

ListExperiments.description_en: Lists experiments and returns only their basic information, not their algorithm configurations. Paging is not supported
ListExperiments.description_zh: 列出实验清单，说明：只展示实验基本信息，不展示算法配置，暂不提供分页功能

ListExtraDataSources.description_en: Lists the data sources for features and samples
ListExtraDataSources.description_zh: 获取特征、样本数据源列表

ListFeatureTables.description_en: Retrieves a list of feature tables

ListFilteringAlgorithms.description_en: Lists information about all recall tables
ListFilteringAlgorithms.description_zh: 列表显示所有的召回表信息

ListFlowControlTaskInvalidItems.description_en: Queries the checklist of invalid items for a traffic control task and returns the item ID (ItemId) and item type (ItemType) for each invalid item
ListFlowControlTaskInvalidItems.description_zh: 查询当前流量调控任务中失效物品清单，返回物品ID(ItemId)与物品类型(ItemType)

ListFlowControlTaskItemReports.description_en: Queries a traffic control task to retrieve its highest-exposure items or invalid items
ListFlowControlTaskItemReports.description_zh: 流量调控曝光排名物品/失效物品查询

ListFlowControlTaskItems.description_en: Previews the items in a traffic control task

ListFlowControlTaskReports.description_en: Lists exposure reports for traffic control tasks
ListFlowControlTaskReports.description_zh: 流量调控任务曝光分析

ListIndexVersions.description_en: Lists the index versions for a specified instance and recall table. This operation returns up to 10 entries, including three switchable versions. Pagination and filtering are not supported
ListIndexVersions.description_zh: 根据指定的实例ID，召回表ID获取索引版本列表。目前仅支持显示10条数据（包含3条可以切换的），所以不用翻页，不用过滤

ListInstance.description_en: Queries the details of one or more instances
ListInstance.description_zh: 查询一个或多个实例的详细信息

ListInstanceTask.description_en: Queries all asynchronous tasks of a specified instance by using the instance ID
ListInstanceTask.description_zh: 查询指定实例的任务列表

ListItems.description_en: Lists the items in the item pool of an instance

ListLogs.description_en: Queries the logs of a specified instance from the last seven days
ListLogs.description_zh: 该接口用于获取指定实例的日志信息（近七日内）

ListMixCategories.description_en: Queries the content types supported in the diversity rule configurations of an instance

ListOfflineStorages.description_en: Queries a list of offline storages

ListRankingModelTemplates.description_en: Returns a list of sorting model templates in descending order by creation time
ListRankingModelTemplates.description_zh: 查看排序模型模板列表，按创建时间倒序

ListRankingModelVersions.description_en: Queries a list of versions for a ranking model

ListRankingSystemHistories.description_en: Queries operation records for a ranking service
ListRankingSystemHistories.description_zh: 查询服务操作记录列表

ListRankingSystems.description_en: Queries a list of ranking services

ListRuleConditions.description_en: Queries item selection rules of an instance
ListRuleConditions.description_zh: 查询实例具体的选品规则

ListRuleTasks.description_en: Queries the status of a rule-specific task

ListSampleFormatConfigs.description_en: Retrieves a list of sample format configurations
ListSampleFormatConfigs.description_zh: 获取样本格式化配置列表

ListSceneParameters.description_en: Retrieves a list of all channels and scenarios for a specified instance
ListSceneParameters.description_zh: 获取指定实例全量的渠道和场景信息列表

ListUmengAppkeys.description_en: Retrieves a list of Umeng appkeys

ListUserClusters.description_en: Lists the user clusters for a specified instance
ListUserClusters.description_zh: 列表显示当前的实例用户cluster

ModifyDataSource.description_en: Modifies the information of a single data source in a table of a specified instance
ModifyDataSource.description_zh: 修改指定表的数据源信息

ModifyFeatureTable.description_en: Modifies a feature table by replacing its entire feature list
ModifyFeatureTable.description_zh: 修改特征表，只支表级别持特征列表的全量修改

ModifyFilteringAlgorithmMeta.description_en: Modifies the configuration of a retrieval table

ModifyInstance.description_en: Modifies the configurations of a specified instance

ModifyItems.description_en: Performs batch operations on an item pool

ModifyOfflineStorages.description_en: Modifies the offline storage configurations of an instance. You need to modify three tables at the same time
ModifyOfflineStorages.description_zh: 修改实例的离线存储配置。（只支持三张表同时修改）

PushDocument.description_en: Pushes documents to a specified table of an instance
PushDocument.description_zh: 向指定实例指定表推送文档

PushIntervention.description_en: This operation pushes intervention data to a specified instance
PushIntervention.description_zh: 该接口用于向指定实例推送干预数据

QueryDataMessage.description_en: Queries update messages in a user data table
QueryDataMessage.description_zh: 用户数据表中的更新消息查询

QueryDataMessageStatistics.description_en: Retrieves statistics for update messages in a data table
QueryDataMessageStatistics.description_zh: 用户数据表中的更新消息统计数据查询

QueryExceptionHistory.description_en: Queries the history of abnormal data for segments
QueryExceptionHistory.description_zh: 异常数据历史分段查询

QueryRawData.description_en: Queries raw data from a user data table
QueryRawData.description_zh: 用户数据表中的原始数据查询

QuerySingleAggregationReport.description_en: Performs an aggregate query on a single table. The data is not updated in real time
QuerySingleAggregationReport.description_zh: 单表聚合查询（数据可能有修改）

QuerySingleReport.description_en: Queries a single table report. More report types may be supported
QuerySingleReport.description_zh: 单表维度分析查询（类型可能会增加）

Recommend.description_en: Retrieves recommendation results for a specified instance
Recommend.description_zh: 该接口用于获取指定实例的推荐结果

RefreshFeatureTable.description_en: Refreshes a feature table from its data source. The refresh policy treats the source table as the ground truth
RefreshFeatureTable.description_zh: 刷新特征表，根据特征表源更新特征表，刷新策略为以用户源表为准

RunInstance.description_en: Runs an instance to start a full data import task
RunInstance.description_zh: 启动实例开始全量数据导入任务

StopDataSet.description_en: Stops a specific version of a dataset for a specified instance
StopDataSet.description_zh: 停止指定实例的指定数据集版本

UnLockIndexVersion.description_en: Unlocks an index version of a retrieval table
UnLockIndexVersion.description_zh: 解锁召回表的索引版本

UpdateExperimentBasicInfo.description_en: Updates the basic information about an experiment

UpdateExperimentConfig.description_en: Updates the configuration of an experiment
UpdateExperimentConfig.description_zh: 更新一个实验配置信息

UpdateExperimentStatus.description_en: Updates the state of an experiment

UpgradeInstance.description_en: Modifies the quotas of a specified instance
UpgradeInstance.description_zh: 更新指定实例配额（Quota）信息

ValidateInstance.description_zh: 校验指定实例信息的有效性
